status: Post-hoc sensitivity analysis of the Phase 5 Fixed Average finding with a second image-only backbone (U-Net); the QaTa-COV19 test split was already examined in Phases 2, 3 and 5. Not an independent confirmation.

scope.img: frozen Phase 0 U-Net, seed matched (results/phase3_checkpoints.tsv rows 20, 22, 24; sha256 checked by src/phase3/infer_img.py)
scope.not_done: no segmentation training, no gate, no SDC, no TransUNet, no weight or threshold search, no new text, no MosMedData+
scope.counts: asserted: 206,595 rows; C4-C6: 2081 images / 472 groups each; C0 and C2: 2113 images / 474 groups each

unet_inference.program: src/phase3/infer_img.py --arch unet --dataset QaTa-COV19 --seeds 1001 1002 1003 --split test (unchanged, inference only)
unet_inference.settings: configs/unet.yaml (deterministic: true), eval mode, no_grad, UNetDataset(train=False), sigmoid output of the model, no TTA
unet_inference.outputs: runs/phase3/test/img/unet/QaTa-COV19/seed<k>/: probs.npz (float32), masks.npz (packbits of P > 0.5), per_case.csv, reconcile_phase0.csv, passes.tsv
unet_inference.test_log: infer_img.py appends start / end rows to results/phase2_test_eval_log.tsv (append-only; not in the Phase 2 lock record); the appended rows are committed with the inference results; their 'Phase 3 IMG test inference' wording comes from the reused program
unet_inference.data_root: test images and masks from LGMS_COMMON_ROOT = ~/datasets/phase1/common224_trainval, whose QaTa-COV19 test and test.txt are links (src/phase1/analysis_lock.py link_test) to ~/datasets/common224/QaTa-COV19/; checked with readlink -f and recorded in reports/PHASE5_PART2_SETUP.md

reconciliation.rule: as the deterministic-model tier of P2-2 (PHASE2_PROTOCOL.md 4.7): for every seed, the mask P > 0.5 must equal the Phase 0 archived PNG mask (runs/unet/QaTa-COV19/seed<k>/eval_test/masks/<id>.png, written from float32 probabilities, src/lgms/runner.py lines 87 and 93) pixel by pixel, and the per-case Dice must equal the archived per_case.csv within 1e-6 (6 stored decimals)
reconciliation.basis: U-Net is run deterministically (configs/unet.yaml line 58) and the Phase 3 validation rerun reproduced the archive exactly (results/phase3_rerun_checks.csv rows 2-4: 0 cases, 0 pixels, 0 Dice difference)
reconciliation.reported: per seed: images with a mask difference, maximum pixel difference, mean and maximum |Delta Dice| (all expected 0)
reconciliation.if_not_identical: stop, find the cause and report; a pipeline error (checkpoint, preprocessing, data) is fixed and that checkpoint is rerun once, both runs recorded; numerical non-determinism: keep the result and report it; never rerun until it passes
reconciliation.program: src/phase5_part2/reconcile_unet.py (run in the inference job) -> results/phase5_part2_unet_img_test_per_case.csv.gz (keys, metrics and reconciliation columns)

inputs.rows_and_groups: results/phase3_feature_labels_test.csv.gz (keys, group), QaTa, conditions C0, C2, C4, C5, C6
inputs.lang: per-case metrics from results/phase2_test_per_case.csv.gz merged on the keys; float32 probability maps from src/phase3/features.py passes(m, 'QaTa-COV19', s, 'test') (the same files as Phase 5, listed in configs/phase5/artifact_manifest.tsv)
inputs.img: U-Net probs.npz, masks.npz and per_case.csv of the inference above, merged on (seed, sample_id)
inputs.ground_truth: lgms.data.load_split_arrays('QaTa-COV19', 'test') under slurm/env_phase1.sh, read in each worker (Pool initializer)
inputs.mask_check: every LANG and U-Net archived mask is checked to equal packbits(P > 0.5) row by row before any output

fixed_average.formula: P_avg = 0.5 * P_lang + 0.5 * P_img_unet, computed in float64 from the stored float32 maps (src/phase5/core.py fixed_average); B_avg = P_avg > 0.5 (a pixel exactly 0.5 is background)
fixed_average.scoring: src/phase5/core.py score_mask = lgms.metrics.case_metrics(mask, gt > 0) plus empty
fixed_average.no_tuning: no weight or threshold is tuned

aggregation.tables: src/phase3/evaluate_gates.py image_weighted (donors within image and seed, then images; mean +- SD over the 3 seeds)
aggregation.paired: src/phase3/stats_phase3.py group_differences (donors within image and seed -> seeds within image -> images within group -> equal-weight groups) and t_over_groups (95% t-interval, ddof 1); no p-values are output
aggregation.main: U-Net Fixed Average - LANG and U-Net Fixed Average - U-Net IMG under C4, C5, C6 per model
aggregation.clean: U-Net Fixed Average - LANG and U-Net IMG - LANG under C0 and C2 per model; no equivalence or safety claim

mixed_reliability.population: common test targets eligible for C4, C5 and C6 (2081 images, 472 groups; asserted); C0 on the same targets
mixed_reliability.expected: E(p) = (1 - p) D(C0) + p D_wrong at p = 0.00, ..., 1.00 for summary values only
mixed_reliability.crossovers: exact (src/phase5/core.py crossover): U-Net Fixed Average vs LANG and vs U-Net IMG; the range of p where it beats both (better_interval, intersect), written as plain floats with its width; repeated with C4, C5 or C6 alone
mixed_reliability.caveat: p is a scenario parameter, not an estimate of report-error prevalence

backbone_consistency.img_clean_dice: image-weighted Dice of IMG under C0 (2113 images, mean of 3 seeds): U-Net from this analysis; nnU-Net read from results/phase5_test_results.csv (strategy IMG, condition C0)
backbone_consistency.gain_over_lang: group-weighted paired Fixed Average - LANG with 95% CI under C4, C5, C6 for both backbones; for nnU-Net computed in Part 2 from the committed Phase 5 per-row results (results/phase5_test_per_case.csv.gz, Fixed Average) and results/phase2_test_per_case.csv.gz (LANG): a descriptive statistic, no new inference
backbone_consistency.nnunet_check: the image-weighted Dice difference Fixed Average - LANG from these per-row data must equal results/phase5_test_results.csv within 1e-6 for every model x condition used; otherwise stop
backbone_consistency.p_range: U-Net from this analysis; nnU-Net read from results/phase5_crossover_summary.csv (better_than_both_p_range, parsed from its np.float64 text)
backbone_consistency.qualitative_conclusion: the judging rule is fixed in reports/PHASE5_PART2_PROTOCOL_FREEZE.md before the test computation (one function in src/phase5_part2/compute.py)

before_the_test_computation: freeze document committed once; manifest sha256 verified; clean tree; HEAD on origin/main; result files absent; the run log is append-only
order: spec, code, synthetic tests and inference job -> U-Net inference and reconciliation, setup report -> manifest and freeze draft -> one test computation -> report
